info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trade Amendments Submission API
info.description: The Trade Amendments Submission API enables users to submit amendments for trade reports within the banking market operations domain. This endpoint allows authorized users to update existing trade submissions identified by a unique submissionId, ensuring compliance and accuracy in reporting. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and compliance officers who need to manage and rectify trade reporting discrepancies efficiently. By facilitating timely amendments, this API plays a crucial role in maintaining accurate market operational records.

post.summary: Submit an amendment for a trade reporting submission.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit an amendment for a specific trade reporting submission identified by the RES-100045 reference. Ensure that all necessary details are included in the request to process the amendment successfully.
